2026-09-14 17:36:27.931 | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-09-14 17:36:27.931 | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-09-14 17:36:27.931 |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-09-14 17:36:27.931 | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-09-14 17:36:27.931 |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-09-14 17:36:27.931 | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-09-14 17:36:27.931 |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-09-14 17:36:27.932 | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
2026-09-14 17:36:27.932 |   instance name specified.
